explain_task.question: Using the revised model’s LP relaxation diagnostics and the original model as a baseline, explain why the revised objective drops from 3050 to 2520 even after adding fairness machinery. Your answer must trace the selected budget-mode costs from the business terms (“family-wide pace policy” and fairness spread) through the exact CSV columns `Cost_budget`, `Cost_balanced`, `Cost_premium` and the code variables `z_budget`, `y[child]`, `max_child_cost`, and `min_child_cost`; then identify at least two binding revised LP-relaxation constraints by exact name with their slack/dual values and interpret their shadow prices in business terms. Finally, pinpoint the exact code additions relative to the original model that changed the objective structure, quantify the -530 change using the chosen children’s parameter values, and explain why the LP dual values cannot be linearly extrapolated to predict the effect of switching from `z_budget=1` to balanced or premium mode in the integer model.
